Function: Configure Drop Rate – Cấu hình tỷ lệ
Business Description: Configure the same Pity probability curve for all banners; base five-star rate is 0.4%, with k=4 exponential growth from roll 60 to 70.

Function: Calculate Summon Probability – Tính xác suất
Business Description: P_n = 0.4% + (100% - 0.4%) * ((n - 60) / 10)^4, for n=60..70; k=4. Applies to all banners. Roll 70 guarantees any five-star Hero in that banner pool, not necessarily Limited/Featured.

Function: Update Pity Counter – Cập nhật Pity
Business Description: Track a separate Pity counter per banner. Apply 0.4% on rolls 1-60, then P_n = 0.4% + (100% - 0.4%) * ((n - 60) / 10)^4, for n=60..70; k=4. Reset after any five-star; no counter carry-over between banners.

Function: Guaranteed Reward – Bảo đảm phần thưởng
Business Description: Bảo đảm nhận một Hero 5 sao bất kỳ ở lượt Pity 70; reset bộ đếm sau khi nhận Hero 5 sao.

Function: Pity Isolation – Tách bộ đếm Pity theo banner
Business Description: Maintain a separate Pity counter for each banner; apply the same probability curve to all banners and do not carry counters between banners.
